cv.summary: Full-stack developer with a background in cybersecurity and governance. Backend developer on Thouq, a group restaurant-recommendation app built as a Holberton capstone project, working with Python, FastAPI and PostgreSQL.

projects.name: Thouq
projects.meta: Backend Developer | Holberton capstone, team of 4 | 2026
projects.desc: App that helps a group choose a restaurant: members enter preferences, the app shortlists places, the group votes.
points: Built the FastAPI backend: phone-number sign-in with SMS verification and JWT, account preferences, and joining an outing by invite code as a member or guest.
Implemented the recommendation engine (filtering, per-person scoring, group aggregation) and the plan, voting and result endpoints.
Added search and filters, saved restaurants, push notifications and concurrency tests; 30 reviewed pull requests merged; deployed on Render with Neon PostgreSQL.
projects.stack: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL (Neon), Render, GitHub Actions
